message.content: In the California gubernatorial race, Xavier Becerra's recorded Palestine-related observations span a May 28, 2024 World Health Assembly speech calling for a ceasefire, hostage release, more humanitarian aid for Gaza, and a two-state path, to a May 2026 exchange in which, asked whether Israel's actions in Gaza were genocide, he criticized Netanyahu's conduct and called for international accountability without confirming the term. In an October 5, 2026 gubernatorial debate, per a WSWS report, he referred to the US-Israeli war in Iran as illegal, though the article noted the criticism addressed form rather than the underlying crime. On recommendation records, CAIR Action and Muslim Democrats of Southern California are listed as endorsing Becerra for the general. Vote for Peace rates him neutral for the general. The Alameda County Jewish Democratic Club, whose stated purpose includes supporting Israel as a secure Jewish state, carried a primary endorsement forward. All documented independent spending supporting Becerra, totaling over twenty million dollars from labor, Latino, and community organizations, carries unestablished Palestine-relevance.
